# AI share of US market cap

What the AI 100 is worth as a share of the whole US stock market, private companies included.

Hover to inspect recorded prices. Click to pin a point; click again to release. Drag between two points to measure the return over that span. Use arrow keys to move, shift with an arrow key to extend a span, Home or End to jump, and Escape to clear.
